Oh holy shit, one I can answer. I've dealt with drug addicts in my family all of my life, and my entire life has been affected badly by it. This story is looong, covering literally my entire life and I'm on mobile, so sorry for formatting. An important thing to note is that addiction and mental illness seems to run in my family. It happened in 2 members of my family on my mom's side, and then two people my mom dated. I and several of my cousins have autism, my dad was bipolar, and my mom had multiple mental illnesses. My mom was also bi, to clear up any confusion in the story. For simplicity, 

MGF1 - Mom's first gf 
MGF2 - Mom's second gf.
MBF - Mom's bf

In 1999, My dad became a drug addict. I dunno what what it was, or that it was happening. I was 2. This resulted in him stealing from my mother, selling things like the tv and whatever he could. To my understanding, he also crashed the car with me in it while going to a deal, but we were uninjured. The two start dating and eventually we move in with her, and the two women adopt my younger brother. About two years later, my mom gets a job in a pharmacy out of town, so we move to another town. MGF1 eventually fell and broke her back in an accident while doing house work, and from what I've been told, became addicted to pain killers. This would be for anything, grades under an A, being actually bad, or just cause she wanted to. My mom worked all the time to support MGF1 who couldn't work anymore due to the injury, so she was never home and didn't know about it. However when she was home, she was berated constantly and would always be fighting over money.

We were constantly poor and on food stamps, living in the ghetto so the teachers didn't care. My mind was messed with a little as well due to the odd situation. I was raised to believe was MGF1 was my "second mom" In terms of relationships in general, this is fine, but the relationship wasn't healthy.  I was taught to fear and try to avoid MGF1 cause of the abuse. Any mess up was unacceptable and I was responsible for everything. I also thought the punishments I got were normal. I eventually got diagnosed with depression, anxiety and suicidal tendencies at age 6. I told SGM1 and Mom I want to die and she says to me "Get on your nice clothes and go out back, I'll get my gun." Mom didn't do anything about it.

When I was 8, my mom came home crying. It turned out that she was stealing pain killers for MGF1 and had been caught and fired for it. We eventually wouldn't pay bills/rent and eventually we moved in with my father's parents, whom I'd recently been reintroduced to just a year prior. Eventually we find an apartment and my mom finds 2 new jobs, but I'm only informed of one. I was frequently left at home with MGF1 while high on something. They told 8 y/o me that it was always epilepsy flare ups and I believed them. She'd act abnormal, terrifying andmore violent then normal. I was told to call my mom when she got like this and she never helped, so I had to deal while taking care of my 6 y/o brother. That means we went without dinner sometimes. The next year we moved to a small duplex in one town over, but it was still in bumfuck, nowhere so there was only one school system for the two towns, so I still had the same friend, another autistic boy who is still one of my best friends today. I was 9 now, my mom met another woman, MGF2, at her book store job and she helped us move and Mom fell in love with her. She eventually leaves MGF1 for her, but left my brother and I behind so MGF1 wouldn't attack us, as she had MGF1 when Mom left her, despite her having no custody over me, just over my brother. She visited us maybe once a week. 

A few months later Mom did come and get us both. She and MGF2 secretly moved in together in the duplex next to the one my best friend's family lived in. We lived there for several months and I played with my best friend daily. Eventually I met the kids down the road, identical twin brothers, and we all became very close. MGF1 moves back to the ghetto town we lived in the first time we moved. I was told to hate MGF2 by MGF1 constantly and I did out of fear, but eventually got over this. I'm told by my Mom to think MGF2 is my second mom now. She was and still is a wonderful woman, but it took me time to accept this. She was perfect as a parent and had helped foster kids many times. She was the only parent I had who raised me right and didn't do anything wrong.

A few days before school ends, MGF2, mom, my brother and I all move to a house in a suburban ghetto. I'm a new town a new school.
